task: Generate K=4 diverse, compliant variant packages for one shortlisted biddeed_reels property and insert them as pending_approval rows with distinct short codes

assertions.input: Title 'Bank lost this house to a stranger… 👀🚨'
Two variant_dna dicts differing on all 6 axes
4-variant set with two variants sharing archetype='shock_number'
assertions.expected: assert_diversity returns ok=False with a duplicate-archetype reason

assertions.input: 4-variant set, pairwise Jaccard < 0.5 between two variants

assertions.expected: scan_banned_terms flags the person-name prose pattern via gate.check_person_name_detector

assertions.input: router_proxy_key unavailable (env unset, vault fetch fails)
assertions.expected: generate_variants_for_reel returns ok=False with a BLOCKED reason, no fabricated variants

assertions.input: LLM returns a set with a caption_groups entry over 5 words

assertions.expected: every returned variant's variant_dna has all 6 axes (archetype, emotion_pair, voice_register, caption_style, music_mood, edit_style) populated

assertions.input: run_for_county for a county with no biddeed_reels row
assertions.expected: returns ok=False, error='no biddeed_reels row found', does not crash
returned row has status='pending_approval' and a non-null short_code (from analyst.mint_variant_short_link)

assertions.input: Two variants inserted for the same reel_id with the same archetype
assertions.expected: second insert fails on the DB unique constraint reel_variants_reel_id_archetype_key

assertions.input: Prompt sent to claude-router for a reel
assertions.expected: prompt contains only sold_amount/assessed_value/delta_pct/condition/county/sale_type -- no buyer/bidder/vendor name field

assertions.input: Claim '4 variants generated' without a returned inserted[] list of length 4
assertions.expected: refuses to report success -- ok=True only when len(inserted)==4
